items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Elvin Evelyn is sitting there... Sonny turned to me and says, 'I want to play Old Devil Moon'... we went from that in to something else; played the whole thing

ctx.x: So Pete sits down at the drums, and Don grabs his bass, and this is a live recording, and Sonny walks out to the

microphone. center stage, and says, "Will Elvin Evan Jones and Wilbur Ware come to the bandstand please?" and it was just like that. So, you know. Pete and Donald had to get up and they came back looking at us, odds but they knew we were gonna play, so it was just the idea that we would play first, so we get up there and Sonny turned to me and says, "I want to play Old Devil Moon" I said, "Wait a minute, Sonny; I'm not too sure of the changes on that one." and (unintelligible) and he laid some changes on me. I…

So I said, "Okay, let's take it" -- and we went from that in to something else; played the whole thing, the whole first side, and then he says, "Look," while they was changing the tapes, "I had to call these fellows up, you know, they were working with me and I want to let them play a tune", and I said, "Isn't that something?" He hired Elvin Evan and I just to play one track and here we wound up playing the whole gig date except for one track '.
